title: Cái này bao nhiêu?
summary: Different ways to say "How much is this?" in Vietnam, with the phrase to start with, useful forms, and related next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Cái này bao nhiêu? answers the traveler question "How much is this" in prices, quantities, payment, and ATM moments. Use this while pointing at an item. Its job is making the price or amount the center of the exchange. The forms below show how tone, setting, or politeness changes the best choice.
